facts.fact: Personnel 会在你得罪职级更高者时随手把你送进惩罚区，前提是你没有 Rabbi。
facts.anchor: Personnel puts you in it at the drop of a hat if you irk someone who ranks higher than you and you don’t have a Rabbi.

facts.fact: CIA 行话里的 Rabbi 指能罩着你的重要靠山，不是神职人员。
facts.anchor: A Rabbi is a protector, somebody important who can look out for you.

facts.fact: Personnel 曾想造一个真正的胶合板惩罚箱，尺寸五乘五乘五。
facts.anchor: tried to have an actual, physical Penalty Box made out of plywood. Their Penalty Box was going to be five by five by five

facts.fact: CIA 总法律顾问办公室（OGC）的政府律师否决了实体惩罚箱方案。
facts.anchor: those scaredy-cat U.S. government lawyers nixed it

facts.fact: 惩罚有时表现为一张飞往没人想去的偏远角落的机票。
facts.anchor: Occasionally it comes in the form of a plane ticket to some god-awful corner of the world nobody wants to go to.

facts.fact: 绝大多数情况下惩罚是把人调去总部小隔间，而多数雇员整个职业生涯都坐这种隔间。
facts.anchor: In the vast majority of cases, though, CIA’s Penalty Box takes the form of a trip straight to a Headquarters cubicle

facts.fact: 被关进惩罚区的通常是太有创意、踩了线的行动人员，他们在总部晃荡且看起来比谁都开心。
facts.anchor: The people they stick in the Penalty Box are usually ops guys who get a little too creative and step in it.

facts.fact: 作者断言整人者迟早有报应，而他们往往直到为时已晚才察觉。
facts.anchor: what goes around comes around, and their day is coming
